label: Auto-resume on load
description: on: resume on session load too · off: never · default: hold on a fresh load, rebind on reload/fork — explicit resume

label: Decision popup
description: on: decision pauses pop the select() picker · off: widget card only — /goal decide reopens the picker

label: Carryover policy
description: new goal over stale paused work — pause: one summary, archive the stale goal, keep list+loop · clear: drop the stale queue too · resume: silent stack

label: Decision pause budget
description: max agent-authored decision pauses per goal before auto-default (0 = relentless from the first; unset = pause every time)

label: Auto-accept drafts
description: on: goal/loop drafts activate without the Confirm dialog (unattended rigs)

label: Aggressive mode
description: ON by default: keep-going defaults (cap 10, stuck 10, wedge off, provider + no-verdict auditor retries, cap→TODOs); autoResume remains explicit global consent; set off for conservative pauses; explicit per-key settings still win

label: Vision assist
description: on: continuation prompts prefer the current model's native vision; confirmed external tools are optional; no vision-only model switch (forbiddenModels gate)

label: Current main agent
description: the active pi session agent/model and thinking level — change it with pi's regular model and thinking selectors

label: Fallback models (up to 10)
description: ordered and deselectable: current main agent → fallback 1 → fallback 2…; every recoverable provider failure switches one eligible fallback at a time

label: Forbidden model patterns
description: case-insensitive substring patterns matched against provider/id; recovery always skips matches, while the explicit-switch gate may block or ledger them

label: Block forbidden switches
description: on: a forbidden selection is reverted to the previous model · off: the switch stands, the violation is still ledgered

label: Main recovery base minutes
description: first retry is eager, later retries use this bounded ladder; an extra :00:30 probe runs after each hour starts; automatic recovery stops after 24h when aggressive mode is OFF — aggressive mode (the default) has no wall-clock expiry, and only a deterministic provider error still stops it

label: Hourly main recovery probe
description: adds a probe at :00:30 while any main-model recovery is parked; off disables only this extra ticker, not the configured retry ladder

label: Primary failback policy
description: auto: a healthy fallback periodically tests the preferred primary · sticky: stay on the fallback until manually changed

label: Primary probe minutes
description: minutes between preferred-primary failback probes while the fallback is serving

label: Drafter agent
description: temporary agent/model used only during /goal, /list, and /loop drafting; after confirmation or interruption the session agent is restored

label: Drafter fallback models (up to 10)
description: ordered and deselectable: current drafter → fallback 1 → fallback 2…; every recoverable provider failure switches one eligible fallback at a time

label: Compaction token target
description: global context-token target; above it, compact opportunistically between work turns or list items, with no tool or audit running; work resumes afterward

label: Compactor agent
description: emergency handoff-brief model used only when context starvation parks the session; unset → verified free big-context registry plan B (never the stuck session model)

label: Compactor fallback models (up to 10)
description: ordered and deselectable: compactor primary → fallback 1 → fallback 2… then registry plan B; no session last resort

label: delegate fallback agents
description: ordered fallback agents; the FIRST eligible provider/model ref is written as the delegate.md override. Empty → falls through to subagentModelOverrides / subagentModelStrategy.

label: oracle fallback agents
description: ordered fallback agents; the FIRST eligible provider/model ref is written as the oracle.md override. Empty → falls through to subagentModelOverrides / subagentModelStrategy.

label: researcher fallback agents
description: ordered fallback agents; the FIRST eligible provider/model ref is written as the researcher.md override. Empty → falls through to subagentModelOverrides / subagentModelStrategy.

label: reviewer fallback agents
description: ordered fallback agents; the FIRST eligible provider/model ref is written as the reviewer.md override. Empty → falls through to subagentModelOverrides / subagentModelStrategy.

label: scout fallback agents
description: ordered fallback agents; the FIRST eligible provider/model ref is written as the scout.md override. Empty → falls through to subagentModelOverrides / subagentModelStrategy.

label: worker fallback agents
description: ordered fallback agents; the FIRST eligible provider/model ref is written as the worker.md override. Empty → falls through to subagentModelOverrides / subagentModelStrategy.

label: Designer fallback agents
description: ordered fallback agents; the FIRST eligible provider/model ref is written as the Designer.md override. Empty → falls through to subagentModelOverrides / subagentModelStrategy.

label: Auditor agent
description: provider/model override for the isolated auditor agent — the fallback chain below runs after this primary; its thinking defaults to the parent session

label: Fallback models (up to 10)
description: ordered and deselectable: auditor primary → fallback 1 → fallback 2…; every recoverable auditor failure advances one eligible candidate at a time, then returns to the session model

label: Allowed extensions
description: pi extension specs the DETACHED auditor may load (e.g. npm:pi-webaio) so extension-provided model providers can run — tools stay restricted to read/grep/find/ls/bash; empty = the default extension-less auditor

label: Mirror session extensions
description: on: the detached auditor also loads the session's own packages so a session-inherited auditor ref resolves in the worker (GLLA itself is never mirrored) — off: only Allowed extensions above, possibly fully isolated

label: Same-model swap
description: when the pinned auditor IS the session model, walk the ordered fallback chain (verifier ≠ executor) — off = same-model audits stand

label: Silent auditor stream
description: on: the auditor's report renders final-only — the widget shows the text at the verdict, never word-by-word · off: live per-token tail

label: Auditor progress signals
description: on: during silent audits the card shows a phase label (reading source… / writing report…) and a report byte-counter so a long pass shows movement · off: plain timer-only card

label: Auditor tool timeout
description: base budget for ONE allowed auditor tool call — every failed retried attempt doubles the effective budget (cap 4× base); raise for slow local models or long bounded verification commands

label: Auditor stall budget
description: base silence/no-progress budget — no new tool call or output for this long aborts the audit; doubles per retried attempt (cap 4× base); an actively generating model never counts as silent

label: Audit job retention
description: how long a finished audit's job dir (session log, result) survives after the worker dies, before `/glla audits health cleanup` reaps it — raise it to keep finished audit logs readable longer; 0 reaps immediately

label: Audit spot-check rate
description: fraction of light-tier audits silently escalated to full (risk-tiered auditing spot-checks) — 0 disables; tune from the spot flip rate in /glla stats challenges

label: Auditor inspection session
description: on: the auditor's pi runs as a normal persistent session (--session <jobDir>/session.jsonl) you can tail -f live or resume after the audit · off: the original --no-session spawn (default)

label: Require full audit challenge
description: on: full-tier approvals require a successful falsification pass, including rework rounds; a failed challenge leaves no verdict · off: preserve round-one approval on challenge failure (default)

label: Audit cap
description: pause the goal after N consecutive disapprovals (0 = unlimited; unset = 10 in aggressive mode, otherwise 5)

label: Audit hard cap
description: hard ceiling on consecutive disapprovals — pauses with a decision even in aggressive mode (0 = unlimited; unset = 8)

label: Mechanical load scaling
description: on: mechanical gate budgets scale with host load up to 2× (default) · off: fixed budgets

label: Audit feedback chars
description: cap the executor-visible disapproval report (0 = full report)

label: Wedge alert minutes
description: hung-command alert while the session is busy (0 = off; unset = 0 in aggressive mode, otherwise 30)

label: Subagent hang action
description: request one child-specific abort after confirmed no progress (0 = warning only)

label: Stuck max interventions
description: consecutive stuck interventions before a loop stops (unset = 10 in aggressive mode, otherwise 5)

label: Stall escalation refires
description: heartbeat refires with no turn before the goal pauses / loop stops (0 = never)

label: Zero-stream retries
description: automatic retries after a busy zero-stream abort (0 = manual only; max 10)

label: Stall short words
description: turns with no tools AND fewer words than this count as a nudge

label: Stall similarity threshold
description: no-tool turns whose text is > this similar to the prior turn count as a nudge (0–1)

label: Subagent model strategy
description: inherit-parent shares your session model; agent-default uses upstream defaults; Designer remains available as a glla role

label: Subagent display richness
description: quiet shows troubled workers only + the count line (default — healthy fan-out lives on the fleet panel); rich shows all worker rows; compact shows the count line only — HUNG is never silent

label: Subagent delegate pin
description: provider/model pin; always wins over strategy

label: Subagent oracle pin
description: provider/model pin; always wins over strategy

label: Subagent researcher pin
description: provider/model pin; always wins over strategy

label: Subagent reviewer pin
description: provider/model pin; always wins over strategy

label: Subagent scout pin
description: provider/model pin; always wins over strategy

label: Subagent worker pin
description: provider/model pin; always wins over strategy

label: Subagent Designer pin
description: provider/model pin; always wins over strategy

label: Subagent delegate thinking
description: thinking-level pin for this subagent type; unset inherits the session level

label: Subagent oracle thinking
description: thinking-level pin for this subagent type; unset inherits the session level

label: Subagent researcher thinking
description: thinking-level pin for this subagent type; unset inherits the session level

label: Subagent reviewer thinking
description: thinking-level pin for this subagent type; unset inherits the session level

label: Subagent scout thinking
description: thinking-level pin for this subagent type; unset inherits the session level

label: Subagent worker thinking
description: thinking-level pin for this subagent type; unset inherits the session level

label: Subagent Designer thinking
description: thinking-level pin for this subagent type; unset inherits the session level

label: Effective resolution
description: effective delegate / oracle / researcher / reviewer / scout / worker / Designer model given current settings

label: State root
description: durable glla state location — workingDir: <cwd>/.pi-glla · sessionDir: top-level Pi session directory (global-only; old root untouched)

label: Notify command
description: custom command ($1 = message) · unset = auto-detect notify-send/osascript · 'off' = silent

label: Token limit per goal
description: per-goal token budget; pause when exceeded (0 = off)

label: Tool overrides
description: project tool visibility overrides; config values are stored only and are not applied to tool execution; Enter opens the editor

label: Postaudit
description: post-completion follow-up enqueuer: mode, triggers, cascade, caps (postaudit / reviewer)

label: Context checkpoint projection
description: off: leave the transcript alone so the provider prefix-cache holds (default) · on: legacy per-turn splice of a bounded continuation checkpoint
